CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: This field is check for the Extra Care flag and check if the Extra Care Review Date is Due
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( CONTAINS(LOWER(TEXT(ExtraCareTimePeriod__c)), "temporarily required"), TODAY() >= ExtraCareReviewDate__c ), IF( AND( INCLUDES(ExtraCareReason__c, "High Risk Scam Victim"), PICKLISTCOUNT(ExtraCareReason__c) == 1 ), IF(($Permission.ManageExtraCareHighRiskScamVictim),TRUE, FALSE), IF(($Permission.ManageExtraCare),TRUE, FALSE) ), FALSE )
CustomField.label: Show Extra Care Alert?
